## UK Pricing

The best price for AOC U27B3A 27" 4K UHD IPS 4ms right now is £138.97, though prices from retailers range from £129.00. The original launch price was £189.99.

## Key Specifications

The U27B3A features a 27" IPS panel with UHD resolution (3840 x 2160) and 60 Hz refresh rate, providing 163 PPI with 10-bit colour depth. Additional features include:

- HDR10 compliance for a more dynamic and lifelike viewing experience
- Adaptive-Sync technology for smooth, tear-free visuals
- 4ms response times and adaptive sync support
- Built-in speakers
- Connectivity includes HDMI 2.0 x 2 ports and DisplayPort 1.4 x 1
